content.title: Which Quality Signal Works in India? A Horse Race of Four Quality Measures
content.abstract: Quality as in investment style focuses on identifying companies with superior quality characteristics that tend to outperform the relatively low quality companies selected on the basis of certain fundamental criteria. The present study attempts to compare the risk and return performance of four widely used quality measures, namely: gross profitability, the Piotroski F-score, Greenblatt’s Magic Formula, and the quality-minus-junk (QMJ) score. The study has selected NSE-listed firms excluding financial firms as universe and covers period starting from October 2002 to December 2025. Equi-weighted
